Structurally, it combines the triad of past phenomena (*atītattika*) with the dyad of root conditions (*hetuduka*) within the systematic matrix of conditional relations that characterizes the *Paṭṭhāna* [Catalog Record; SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs the text as an untranslated leaf node with no separate English title [SuttaCentral].
